query:
UPDATE vat_groups
         SET name = $3,
             vat_amount = $4,
             default_group = COALESCE($5, default_group),
             country = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $7 ELSE country END,
             meta = CASE WHEN $8 THEN $9 ELSE meta END,
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1 AND workspace_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
